goal: Extend canonical TELE with RX-only observation of Vanilla party/group server packets so roster, leader and party command state can be proven before enabling invite mutations.
notes: TELE-03 is RX-only for group state. Observe SMSG_GROUP_INVITE/GROUP_CANCEL/GROUP_DECLINE/GROUP_UNINVITE/GROUP_SET_LEADER/GROUP_DESTROYED/GROUP_LIST/PARTY_COMMAND_RESULT/UMSG_UPDATE_GROUP_MEMBERS. No CMSG_GROUP_* mutations are permitted in this stage.
